name: Trip story
summary: A tap-through recap story of a group trip: cover, route, best moment, MVP, costs, and who's in for next year.
useWhen: after a group trip, with real facts from the chat: where, when, stops, costs
someone asks for a recap of the trip
dontUseWhen: planning a trip that has not happened
no costs or stops were given: never invent them

params.stops: 2 to 6 places in visit order, label + map position x,y in 0..1
params.moment: caption of the moment the group picked
